cards.heading: q001 · §V, implicate order
cards.paraphrase: Bohm proposes enfolding/unfolding as primary and discrete objects as derivative stabilities. His qualification is degree: the whole is involved in a region without every region being an exhaustive readable copy. This is his proposed interpretation.

cards.heading: q002 · §VI, meaning and value
cards.paraphrase: He connects the organization of thought, human action and the world affected by action. His ethical appeal extends the interpretation; it is not independent experimental confirmation of it.

cards.heading: q003 · §III, vortex comparison
cards.paraphrase: Bohm treats the vortex as a relatively stable pattern of moving water, not an independently existing substance. This is his explanatory comparison.

cards.heading: q002 · concluding exchanges on knowledge and reality
cards.locator: concluding exchanges on knowledge and reality
cards.paraphrase: Thought can mistake its own reflexive activity for an independently existing object. The speakers explore correcting that independence claim while retaining functional knowledge. Krishnamurti questions Bohm's account of energy and their common root; their formulations must retain that disagreement.

cards.heading: q001 · PDF 2–3
cards.paraphrase: Dialogue permits meaning to develop through participants. Discussion's contest for a winning opinion is contrasted with inquiry into assumptions inherited through culture and identified with oneself. A felt threat to an opinion can disclose those assumptions.

cards.heading: q002 · PDF 4–6
cards.paraphrase: Tacit habits and group roles enter the inquiry. Facilitation serves a practice capable of continuing without a permanent directive authority. Suspension neither enacts nor suppresses an assumption: its activity can become available for attention. Bohm's unnamed anthropological anecdote does not establish a universal Indigenous practice.

cards.heading: q003 · PDF 7–9
cards.paraphrase: Participation in developing meaning need not make opinions identical or erase individuals. Frustration, anger and anxiety belong to the inquiry; shared meaning is not guaranteed harmony. These are descriptions and proposals for practice, not controlled evidence of an intervention's outcomes.

cards.heading: q001 · answer to the request for an implicate/explicate example
cards.locator: answer to the request for an implicate/explicate example
cards.paraphrase: The dye becomes distributed through viscous fluid and returns to a visible drop when the movement reverses. Bohm compares this with information distributed through a holographic plate. The illustration distinguishes hidden organization from absence.

cards.heading: q002 · question on mind in relation to implicate and explicate order
cards.locator: question on mind in relation to implicate and explicate order
cards.paraphrase: Bohm proposes parallelism between implicit meaning and material enfoldment, explicitly calling for further development. The proposal does not settle artificial phenomenality.

cards.heading: q001 · Part I, chapter II, §II, printed 21–22 / PDF 48–49
cards.locator: Part I, chapter II, §II, printed 21–22 / PDF 48–49
cards.paraphrase: Creativity, many and one form the Category of the Ultimate. The achieved singular entity unifies the received diversity and enters the diversity available for further becoming. Whitehead expressly distinguishes this sense of one from the integral number. Concrescence names the production of novel togetherness, not merely the rearrangement of a given aggregate.

cards.heading: q002 · Part I, chapter II, §II, printed 23–26 / PDF 50–53
cards.locator: Part I, chapter II, §II, printed 23–26 / PDF 50–53
cards.paraphrase: Becoming constitutes an entity's being. Prehension distinguishes subject, datum and subjective form; consciousness is not necessary to each prehension. Objectification names one actual entity's functioning in another's self-creation. Satisfaction is the fully determinate final integration. These metaphysical terms are not automatically measurements of an artificial agent.

cards.heading: q003 · Part II, chapter I, printed 59–60 / PDF 85–86
cards.locator: Part II, chapter I, printed 59–60 / PDF 85–86
cards.paraphrase: A real essence involves the specific relations through which an actuality has its status. The loss of individual absoluteness in perishing is coordinated with objective immortality: the achieved occasion belongs to further generation. This does not identify perishing with erasure or assert persistence of the original subject's immediacy.

cards.heading: q001 · chapter II, displayed pp.100–106
cards.paraphrase: Duration concerns successive conscious states permeating one another. Melody illustrates a qualitative whole changed by the next note. Setting moments beside one another changes the object into a spatial representation. The argument preserves successive development without treating it as a row of interchangeable units.

cards.heading: q002 · chapter II, displayed pp.108–112
cards.paraphrase: Counting a clock's simultaneous indications is distinguished from the conscious synthesis retaining successive movements. The space traversed and the act of traversing have different offices in the analysis. A technical timestamp is therefore not, merely through accurate recording, a demonstration of this phenomenal duration.

Melody illustrates a qualitative whole changed by the next note. Setting moments beside one another changes the object into a spatial representation. The argument preserves successive development without treating it as a row of interchangeable units. **q002 · chapter II, displayed pp.108–112.** Counting a clock's simultaneous indications is distinguished from the conscious synthesis retaining successive movements. The space traversed and the act of traversing have different offices in the analysis.
